parts.script:
Alice: Hey Mark, have you thought about our weekend trip? I think it’s time we finalize our plans!  
Mark: Yes, I was thinking we could head to the lake. It’s been ages since we went camping.  
Alice: Sounds good! Do you remember which campsite we used last time?  
Mark: I believe it was Pine Ridge. They had those beautiful views.  
Alice: Right! We should book it soon, as it might fill up quickly. What do you think about the activities?  
Mark: I’d love to do some hiking and maybe rent a canoe.  
Alice: Perfect! We can also bring some board games for the evenings.  
Mark: Great idea! I’ll check the weather as well to make sure we’re prepared.  
Alice: Good call. Let’s plan to leave early Saturday morning and come back Sunday afternoon.  
Mark: Agreed! I’ll handle the booking and you can bring the food?  
Alice: Sure, I’ll make a list of what we need to buy before we leave.  
Mark: Awesome, I can’t wait for this trip!  
Alice: Me too! It’s going to be fun!
